messages: kevin: quick question on confirm patterns we want an inline confirm for Enable autoscaling (smaller surface) instead of a modal. thoughts on accessibility and affordance? maria: inline confirm is nicer for flow, but must behave like a dialog for a11y (trap focus, announce). otherwise screen reader users miss it. aj: agree. keep it small but add clear text: 'Enable autoscaling? Pool may scale between X and Y GPUs.' show est cost delta. priya: implementation note: reuse our InlineConfirm component that sets role=\"dialog\" and calls focusTrap.start(). Also return analytics event. sam: disabled CTA states need aria-describedby pointing to reason. example snippet: ``` Burst not supported on this pool ``` maria: microcopy: use 'Enable autoscaling' (CTA) + 'Edit min/max' (secondary). For locked pools header: 'Capacity locked'. add a small helper: 'Est. +$0.14/hr' when available. kevin: thanks i'll update the spec and add acceptance: focus trap, sr announcement, tooltip keyboard focus, cost toggle for private installs. design-bot: preview link? design-bot: https://preview.redwood.design/branch/inline-autoscale-confirm (includes keyboard walkthrough). kevin: perfect, i'll post the updated figma and tag for final signoff.
